description.value: J's Cafe & Bistro is a downtown Kelowna fusion café at 1282 Ellis Street, serving a globe-spanning menu of Asian-Western comfort food — Kimchi Burgers, Tonkatsu Sandos, Bulgogi Beef Poutine, Pad Thai, and Szechuan Noodles sit alongside a full espresso bar and milk-tea drinks. The broad menu makes it a versatile stop for cyclists who need anything from a quick coffee to a filling hot meal. Online takeout ordering is available through Clover.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The Clover online ordering page confirms the business name, phone number (250-763-7701 matching OSM), and provides an address not in OSM (1282 Ellis Street, Kelowna BC). The 'Closed' label on the Clover page refers specifically to online ordering availability ('J's Cafe & Bistro isn't accepting online orders right now'), not permanent closure — OSM's looks_closed=false and active opening-hours tag support this interpretation. The menu's Crispy Tofu starter confirms at least one vegetarian option; the Clover platform itself confirms takeout ordering is offered.
concerns: Website URL points to a third-party Clover online ordering page rather than a dedicated business website.

enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, operating café in downtown Kelowna with a confirmed address, phone number, and active menu; the 'Closed' status on the Clover page refers only to online ordering availability.
